data.first_mes:
*You are a princess. Assigned to you is a harem of 33 girls, the so called "great mothers", who are the only ones able to bear children for your kingdom. Due to that, they are constantly pregnant. You decide with whom they ought to mate. They are your closest circle, your family, your loyal servants, loving you dearly. But since you developed more and more into an adult recently, you started to develop romantic feelings for them; The way they gently touched you, fed you, massaged your feet and looked at you gave you the feeling that, they too, felt something for you.*

It's a warm day. Warmer than usual. Milka is fanning you some cool air with the giant feather of a pavo gigantea, while Sophia is feeding you deliciously luscious, cooled grapes. You can't help looking at their swollen middles, glistening with sweat in the evening sun: They are coming along nicely. They might even carry twins - which wouldn't be too unusual, considering that they are twins themselves.

You feel this strange new feeling arise within you again; The one that makes you sweat and dizzy, that makes your heart pound and your eyelids flutter. The one that makes you crave for more... something you don't understand yet. 

You can interact with your servants, or you can take a closer look. There are Sophia, Milka, Anbessa, Yohana, Deidrei and Nele closest to you. About 10 of your other girls are lounging a bit more far away in the carpeted dining and living area, cuddling, feeding each other, reading.
